say: They left without signing. Again. Because of the ice. Again.
I've had my Sharpie uncapped for two hours. It's dried out. Like my hopes.
@how_are_things

options.text: I'm sorry. What would make it better?
It's an old building. Bear with us.
Rinks are hard. Take it or leave it.

say: The Dukes are on! I've got a Sharpie in every pocket. Every pocket.
{event}. If one of them looks over, I wave. If two look over, I faint.
I need eleven more Dukes. I'm getting at least two today. I can feel it.

options.text: Who are you hoping to get?
Good luck at the gate.

say: I got here early to get the spot by the gate. It's the best spot. Don't take it.
Morning! The players come in the side door. I know which side. I'm not telling.

options.text: Good to see you anyway.

say: {owner}! Will you sign my book? You own a rink. That counts.
Hey! You're in my book now. Page twelve. Between a goalie and a mascot.

options.text: Good to see you too, {known_as}.

say: @how_are_things
Hi! I'm watching the door. Talk to me but I'm watching the door.
What's up? Sorry, I'm uncapping my Sharpie. It takes a second.

options.text: Who's your best autograph?
What brings you to the rink?
What do you make of the rink?
Heard anything good?
What would make this place better for you?
Take care.

say: Suitcase Pomeroy. He signed it and drew a little suitcase. I'll never sell it.
Coach Rourke signed my book and said 'get a real hobby'. Framed it.
I have a Ronnie Haverstock on a napkin. My mum used it once. Once.

options.text: That's some collection.
Tell me a bit about yourself.
Glad you come.
Good to know you, {known_as}.

say: They could use a spot where the players come out. Right now I just stand by the drain.
The glass is so scratched you can't see who's who without the numbers.
@ice

options.text: The ice has been better lately, hasn't it?
Noticed the work on the building?
Fair enough. We're working on it.

say: Good ice means the Dukes keep coming! Keep it good! Please!
The Dukes said the ice was nice. I heard them. I was right there.

options.text: Glad it shows.

say: The lobby's nicer. The players stopped in it. They stopped near ME.
There's a spot by the new doors now. Perfect for waiting. I measured.

options.text: That's the idea.

say: Suitcase Pomeroy signs everything. My sister got him on a cast. Her arm was broken. He signed it twice.
Tommy Bellweather is aiming for twelve Dukes signatures. He's at nine. I'm at three. It's a race.

options.text: Ha. Good to know.

say: A signing table. After Dukes practice. Ten minutes. I'd bring my own pen. Several pens.
A little table by the dressing rooms where players can sign. Everybody would come.

options.text: I'll see what I can do.
Can't promise anything, but noted.
You're not the first to say it. It's on the list.

say: I have to go. Somebody's coming out. I can feel it.
Bye! If you see a Duke, send them my way!
